 ORDER Heard on IA No.4402 of 2024, which is an application for taking additional documents on record.
2. Documents may be relevant for proper adjudication of this petition.
Therefore, IA is allowed and documents are taken on record.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent / State has informed this Court that notice has been duly served upon the prosecutrix.

4. This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.133/2022 registered at Police Station Sanwer, District Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 366-A, 376(2)(N) and 376(3) of IPC Shyam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59057122/
1 and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 07/05/2022.
5. After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application with a direction to the trial Court to conclude the trial at an early date.
6. Accordingly, the third bail application preferred under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn.
7 . Applicant is suffering jail incarceration for more than one and half years, therefore, trial Court is directed to make all possible endeavour to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible.
